result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with a marked continental crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the crossing distance is significant without a median refuge or active signalization.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: No traffic signals or stop signs are visible to regulate vehicle flow at the pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install user-actuated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and pedestrian signals, providing a basic level of safety. However, the wide roadway lacks physical traffic calming measures such as curb extensions or a median refuge, leaving pedestrians exposed during the crossing.

hazards.name: Long unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire width of the roadway without a median refuge.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-density urban intersection with standard pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks, traffic signals, and marked crosswalks. However, the wide multi-lane roadway and the presence of large vehicles in the foreground create significant visual obstructions and potential for higher traffic speeds.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A large SUV in the foreground significantly blocks the sightlines between pedestrians at the curb and approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Multi-lane One-way Traffic
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane one-way street configuration can encourage higher vehicle speeds and creates a multiple-threat risk for pedestrians crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse crosswalk markings to high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.
